evidence.title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation

summary: DECOWAM is a decoupled whole-body world-action model designed to enhance the capabilities of legged robots in mobile manipulation tasks. The innovation aims to improve autonomy and adaptability in dynamic environments.
title: Researchers Introduce DECOWAM: A New AI Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
